request:
Give the local gate a single command by moving the validator-and-test chain out of package.json into one checked-in Node script.

SCOPE — exactly 3 files:
1. scripts/test-all.js (new)
2. scripts/build-agent-dist.js (the package.json template)
3. package.json (GENERATED — regenerated from that template, never hand-edited)

WHY. package.json is generated by build-agent-dist.js, and its `test:gates` value is one enormous `&&` chain naming 6 validators, an eval run and 8 test files. That list exists in three places (the package.json value, the template, the CI workflow) and nothing compares them; the review already found them drifted. Collapsing it to one script removes two of the three copies, makes `npm test` a single command a contributor can run on any OS, and stops the chain from depending on shell-specific `&&` semantics.

DELIVERABLE — scripts/test-all.js, zero dependencies, Node stdlib only, same house style as scripts/run-hook-tests.js (shebang, a header comment that says why the file exists, exit codes documented):
- A single ordered STEPS array, each entry a human label plus the argv to run, so the list is readable and greppable in one place. It must contain, in this order:
  * node scripts/validate-skills.js
  * node scripts/validate-versions.js
  * node scripts/validate-reference-links.js
  * node scripts/validate-commands.js
  * node scripts/validate-artifact-paths.js
  * node scripts/validate-catalog.js
  * node scripts/run-evals.js --min-rank1 95
  * node scripts/lib/skill-lint-test.js
  * node scripts/validate-versions-test.js
  * node scripts/run-evals-test.js
  * node scripts/validate-reference-links-test.js
  * node scripts/validate-commands-test.js
  * node scripts/validate-artifact-paths-test.js
  * node scripts/floor-guard-reference-test.js
  * node scripts/validate-catalog-test.js
  * node scripts/uninstall-test.js
- Run each step with spawnSync in the repo root, stdio inherited so the child's own output is what a contributor reads, and STOP at the first non-zero status — print which step failed and exit with its code. Do not swallow a failure by continuing.
- Each test file must be run as `node <file>` (a plain node invocation), NOT as `node --test <files>`: node:test files run and set a non-zero exit code when executed directly, and the plain form is what this repo's harness accepts.
- Print one line per step as it starts, and a final summary line naming how many steps passed.
- Export the STEPS array (module.exports) so a future test can assert the list without shelling out.

Then change the template's `test:gates` in scripts/build-agent-dist.js (line 218) to `node scripts/test-all.js` and regenerate package.json with `node scripts/build-agent-dist.js`. `test` stays `npm run test:gates && npm run test:hooks`, and build/prepare/uninstall/test:hooks are untouched. Add a short comment above the template's scripts block saying package.json is generated and this is the source.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA — report the actual command output for each
- `node scripts/test-all.js` runs all 16 steps and exits 0 on this tree; report the per-step lines and the final summary.
- Prove it fails correctly: break one step temporarily (for example run the script with an env var or a temp copy that points one step at a missing file — do NOT leave any breakage behind) and show that it stops at that step and exits non-zero. Restore afterwards and re-run to green.
- `node scripts/build-agent-dist.js` twice leaves `git status --porcelain -- package.json` unchanged, and package.json's test:gates reads exactly `node scripts/test-all.js`.
- `node scripts/validate-versions.js` still reports 0.6.13 (package.json version untouched).
- No new dependency; no other file touched.

Report per-file changes, every command with its output, and anything left out.
